【自編練習｜sourceType: selfCreated】

第 19 課自編練習：逐題詳解

  1. 1. decided to ______ the conclusion.

    (A) revise　(B) revision　(C) revised　(D) revising

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：decided to + base verb；revise the conclusion 表示修改結論。

    其他選項：revision 是名詞；revised 是過去式／分詞；revising 是 V-ing，三者都不能放在 decided to 後。

  2. 2. had to ______ the timetable.

    (A) adjust　(B) adjustment　(C) adjusted　(D) adjusting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：had to + base verb；adjust the timetable 是正確搭配。

    其他選項：adjustment 是名詞；adjusted 與 adjusting 都不符合 had to 後的原形要求。

  3. 3. the paragraph ______ a different cause.

    (A) indicated　(B) indication　(C) indicating　(D) indicates

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：主詞 reading／paragraph 的敘述在過去脈絡，indicated 是完整過去式。

    其他選項：indication 是名詞；indicating 不能作主要動詞；indicates 是現在式，與過去脈絡不一致。

  4. 4. they ______ to the next question.

    (A) proceed　(B) proceeding　(C) proceeded　(D) procedure

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：they 後用 proceed；proceed to the next question 是固定搭配。

    其他選項：proceeding 是 V-ing；proceeded 是過去式；procedure 是名詞。

  5. 5. each school ______ it in practice.

    (A) applies　(B) application　(C) applied　(D) applying

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：each school 是單數，且句子描述 will depend 下的實行方式，所以用 applies。

    其他選項：application 是名詞；applied 是過去式；applying 是 V-ing，皆不能作此處謂語。

  6. 6. instead of ______ a conclusion.

    (A) infer　(B) inference　(C) inferred　(D) inferring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 D：instead of + V-ing；inferring a conclusion 表示下結論。

    其他選項：infer 是原形；inference 是名詞；inferred 是過去式／分詞，均不接 instead of。

  7. 7. each measurement ______.

    (A) occurred　(B) occurs　(C) occurrence　(D) occurring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 B：each measurement 是單數，且圖表描述一般事實，使用 occurs。

    其他選項：occurred 改成過去事件；occurrence 是名詞；occurring 是分詞，均不能作此處謂語。

  8. 8. the example ______ included.

    (A) is　(B) be　(C) being　(D) was

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：被動句需要 is included；example 是單數的一般說明。

    其他選項：be 需其他助動詞；being 不是完整謂語；was 會把一般說明錯改成過去。

  9. 9. that ______ the meaning.

    (A) distorts　(B) distortion　(C) distorted　(D) distorting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：that 指單數 sentence，distorts the meaning 是現在式主句。

    其他選項：distortion 是名詞；distorted 是過去式／分詞；distorting 是 V-ing。

  10. 10. paragraphs ______ every task.

    (A) address　(B) addresses　(C) addressed　(D) addressing

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：both paragraphs 是複數，address every task 表示處理每項要求。

    其他選項：addresses 是單數；addressed 是過去式；addressing 是 V-ing，均不符合現在式複數謂語。

【自編練習｜sourceType: selfCreated】

第 20 課自編練習：逐題詳解

  1. 1. decided to ______ the conclusion.

    (A) revise　(B) revision　(C) revised　(D) revising

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：decided to + base verb；revise the conclusion 表示修改結論。

    其他選項：revision 是名詞；revised 是過去式／分詞；revising 是 V-ing，三者都不能放在 decided to 後。

  2. 2. had to ______ the timetable.

    (A) adjust　(B) adjustment　(C) adjusted　(D) adjusting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：had to + base verb；adjust the timetable 是正確搭配。

    其他選項：adjustment 是名詞；adjusted 與 adjusting 都不符合 had to 後的原形要求。

  3. 3. the paragraph ______ a different cause.

    (A) indicated　(B) indication　(C) indicating　(D) indicates

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：主詞 reading／paragraph 的敘述在過去脈絡，indicated 是完整過去式。

    其他選項：indication 是名詞；indicating 不能作主要動詞；indicates 是現在式，與過去脈絡不一致。

  4. 4. they ______ to the next question.

    (A) proceed　(B) proceeding　(C) proceeded　(D) procedure

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：they 後用 proceed；proceed to the next question 是固定搭配。

    其他選項：proceeding 是 V-ing；proceeded 是過去式；procedure 是名詞。

  5. 5. each school ______ it in practice.

    (A) applies　(B) application　(C) applied　(D) applying

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：each school 是單數，且句子描述 will depend 下的實行方式，所以用 applies。

    其他選項：application 是名詞；applied 是過去式；applying 是 V-ing，皆不能作此處謂語。

  6. 6. instead of ______ a conclusion.

    (A) infer　(B) inference　(C) inferred　(D) inferring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 D：instead of + V-ing；inferring a conclusion 表示下結論。

    其他選項：infer 是原形；inference 是名詞；inferred 是過去式／分詞，均不接 instead of。

  7. 7. each measurement ______.

    (A) occurred　(B) occurs　(C) occurrence　(D) occurring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 B：each measurement 是單數，且圖表描述一般事實，使用 occurs。

    其他選項：occurred 改成過去事件；occurrence 是名詞；occurring 是分詞，均不能作此處謂語。

  8. 8. the example ______ included.

    (A) is　(B) be　(C) being　(D) was

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：被動句需要 is included；example 是單數的一般說明。

    其他選項：be 需其他助動詞；being 不是完整謂語；was 會把一般說明錯改成過去。

  9. 9. that ______ the meaning.

    (A) distorts　(B) distortion　(C) distorted　(D) distorting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：that 指單數 sentence，distorts the meaning 是現在式主句。

    其他選項：distortion 是名詞；distorted 是過去式／分詞；distorting 是 V-ing。

  10. 10. paragraphs ______ every task.

    (A) address　(B) addresses　(C) addressed　(D) addressing

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：both paragraphs 是複數，address every task 表示處理每項要求。

    其他選項：addresses 是單數；addressed 是過去式；addressing 是 V-ing，均不符合現在式複數謂語。

第 20 課專屬小考（8 題）

  1. 建立 115 混合題的文本／觀點／證據表。
  2. 說明原字到字形變化的步驟。
  3. 用一條證據判斷一個多選項。
  4. 解釋簡答不能抄整段的原因。
  5. 比較 innovation 與 innovative 的詞性。
  6. 解釋 one of a kind 與 uniqueness。
  7. 指出跨文本移植資訊的錯誤。
  8. 用兩句話完成 evidence-based answer。

第 21 課

中譯英 I：句子骨架與零失誤

本課驗收目標

官方中譯英的句子骨架；所有歷屆資料以完整題卡呈現。

正式教學：中譯英 I：句子骨架與零失誤

官方中譯英的句子骨架。先寫出句法訊號、上下文或原文證據，再做排除。

111–115 官方中譯英：兩句完整逐句教學

115 官方原題 1、2

1. 中文：現在越來越多高中英文老師已經增加在課堂上使用英文的百分比。

查看參考答案與解析

切塊／S/V/O：S + V + not A but B / While + V-ing, S + V

時態／target chunks：依官方語意保留；檢查主詞動詞、冠詞、介系詞與拼字。

安全版：Now, more and more senior high school English teachers have increased the percentage of English used in class.

自然版：Now, more and more senior high school English teachers have increased the percentage of English used in class.

常見錯誤／扣分點：漏核心意群、時態／單複數／介系詞／拼字錯誤。

2. 中文：他們將學生依英語能力分成不同組別，進行多樣的聽、說活動。

查看參考答案與解析

切塊／S/V/O：They / divide students into different groups / based on English ability / and conduct activities

時態／target chunks：依官方語意保留；檢查主詞動詞、冠詞、介系詞與拼字。

安全版：They divide students into different groups based on English ability and conduct various listening and speaking activities.

自然版：They divide students into different groups based on English ability and conduct various listening and speaking activities.

常見錯誤／扣分點：漏核心意群、時態／單複數／介系詞／拼字錯誤。

自然版：Human imagination and creativity are the strongest driving forces for technological advancement.

【自編練習｜sourceType: selfCreated】

第 21 課自編練習：逐題詳解

  1. 1. decided to ______ the conclusion.

    (A) revise　(B) revision　(C) revised　(D) revising

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：decided to + base verb；revise the conclusion 表示修改結論。

    其他選項：revision 是名詞；revised 是過去式／分詞；revising 是 V-ing，三者都不能放在 decided to 後。

  2. 2. had to ______ the timetable.

    (A) adjust　(B) adjustment　(C) adjusted　(D) adjusting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：had to + base verb；adjust the timetable 是正確搭配。

    其他選項：adjustment 是名詞；adjusted 與 adjusting 都不符合 had to 後的原形要求。

  3. 3. the paragraph ______ a different cause.

    (A) indicated　(B) indication　(C) indicating　(D) indicates

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：主詞 reading／paragraph 的敘述在過去脈絡，indicated 是完整過去式。

    其他選項：indication 是名詞；indicating 不能作主要動詞；indicates 是現在式，與過去脈絡不一致。

  4. 4. they ______ to the next question.

    (A) proceed　(B) proceeding　(C) proceeded　(D) procedure

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：they 後用 proceed；proceed to the next question 是固定搭配。

    其他選項：proceeding 是 V-ing；proceeded 是過去式；procedure 是名詞。

  5. 5. each school ______ it in practice.

    (A) applies　(B) application　(C) applied　(D) applying

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：each school 是單數，且句子描述 will depend 下的實行方式，所以用 applies。

    其他選項：application 是名詞；applied 是過去式；applying 是 V-ing，皆不能作此處謂語。

  6. 6. instead of ______ a conclusion.

    (A) infer　(B) inference　(C) inferred　(D) inferring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 D：instead of + V-ing；inferring a conclusion 表示下結論。

    其他選項：infer 是原形；inference 是名詞；inferred 是過去式／分詞，均不接 instead of。

  7. 7. each measurement ______.

    (A) occurred　(B) occurs　(C) occurrence　(D) occurring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 B：each measurement 是單數，且圖表描述一般事實，使用 occurs。

    其他選項：occurred 改成過去事件；occurrence 是名詞；occurring 是分詞，均不能作此處謂語。

  8. 8. the example ______ included.

    (A) is　(B) be　(C) being　(D) was

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：被動句需要 is included；example 是單數的一般說明。

    其他選項：be 需其他助動詞；being 不是完整謂語；was 會把一般說明錯改成過去。

  9. 9. that ______ the meaning.

    (A) distorts　(B) distortion　(C) distorted　(D) distorting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：that 指單數 sentence，distorts the meaning 是現在式主句。

    其他選項：distortion 是名詞；distorted 是過去式／分詞；distorting 是 V-ing。

  10. 10. paragraphs ______ every task.

    (A) address　(B) addresses　(C) addressed　(D) addressing

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：both paragraphs 是複數，address every task 表示處理每項要求。

    其他選項：addresses 是單數；addressed 是過去式；addressing 是 V-ing，均不符合現在式複數謂語。

In recent years, pets in Taiwan have become more than animals kept at home. People buy special food and clothes, take pets to friendly places, and celebrate their birthdays. These actions show that pets are often treated as companions or family members.

Smaller families and busy lives may make people seek companionship from animals. Pets can provide emotional support, but keeping one is a lifelong commitment. Owners must pay for food and medical care and provide a safe home. If they cannot accept this responsibility, animals may be abandoned. Before adopting an animal, people should consider their schedule and budget. They should also learn about exercise, training, and emergency care. Responsible owners do not treat a pet as a temporary decoration. They understand that affection must be supported by daily action, patience, and a willingness to stay with the animal during difficult times.

This detail makes the example concrete and shows how the writer connects the situation to an everyday consequence for the community.

A typhoon day can create two different situations. Some students stay home, attend online classes, and help their families. Others, including nurses and emergency workers, still need to travel in heavy rain. The same holiday can therefore feel relaxing to one person and stressful to another.

I support suspending work and classes when transportation is dangerous. Last year, my school closed because strong winds made the roads unsafe. I attended an online lesson and organized my notes at home. Safety should come before convenience, but everyone should use the day responsibly. At the same time, a suspension cannot remove every difficulty. Some parents cannot stay home, and some students may lack a quiet room or reliable internet. Schools should provide recorded lessons and clear instructions. Local governments should explain decisions early so families can prepare transportation, food, and childcare safely.

This detail makes the example concrete and shows how the writer connects the situation to an everyday consequence for the community.

P1/P2 解析：P1 與 P2 分別完成題目動詞，不把任務只留在 outline。

Among the problems shown, I would choose academic pressure. Tests, assignments, and activities often arrive together, so teenagers may stay up late and feel anxious. This pressure can also reduce their interest in learning and family time.

My robot assistant would divide large tasks into smaller steps, remind me of deadlines, and suggest a realistic schedule. I would make decisions and study, while the robot handled routine planning. It should also notice exhaustion and suggest asking a teacher or parent for help. Robots can organize information, but human empathy and judgment remain necessary. The robot should protect my privacy and allow me to change its suggestions. It must not make me feel guilty when I need a break. A helpful machine is a tool, not a replacement for friends, teachers, or parents. With this division of labor, I could become more independent without losing human support.

This detail makes the example concrete and shows how the writer connects the situation to an everyday consequence for the community.

P1/P2 解析：P1 與 P2 分別完成題目動詞，不把任務只留在 outline。

People like emojis because they express emotions quickly and add tone to short messages. A smiling face can make a sentence warmer, while a crying face can show sadness. Emojis are useful online because readers cannot hear the writer’s voice.

However, one symbol may have different meanings. I once sent an emoji that I thought was funny, but my friend thought I was laughing at her problem. To solve this problem, people should consider context and explain their meaning with words when necessary. This experience taught me that digital communication needs patience. A sender should not assume that a receiver shares the same cultural background or sense of humor. Asking a simple follow-up question is often better than arguing about a symbol. In this way, technology can support relationships and reduce unnecessary conflict.

This detail makes the example concrete and shows how the writer connects the situation to an everyday consequence for the community.

P1/P2 解析：P1 與 P2 分別完成題目動詞，不把任務只留在 outline。

低分句：It is very good and important.　修改版：用明確對象、動作、原因與結果取代空泛形容。

111｜公園｜word count: 181

Park A offers open exercise space, while Park B provides trees, benches, and a quiet walking path. One is active and energetic; the other is peaceful and suitable for rest. Both are useful because a community needs places for movement as well as relaxation.

My ideal park would combine the two designs. It would have a safe playground, a walking path, shaded seats, green grass, and ramps for people with disabilities. I would also add a community garden. Children could play, adults could exercise, and older people could talk under the trees. Such a park would keep residents healthy and help neighbors build relationships. A park should not be designed for only one age group. Clear paths, drinking fountains, clean public toilets, and signs would make the space easier to use. Weekend activities could bring families together, while quiet corners would give busy workers a chance to recover. Good design can make a public place welcoming and safe for everyone.

This detail makes the example concrete and shows how the writer connects the situation to an everyday consequence for the community.

第 23 課自編練習：逐題詳解

  1. 1. decided to ______ the conclusion.

    (A) revise　(B) revision　(C) revised　(D) revising

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：decided to + base verb；revise the conclusion 表示修改結論。

    其他選項：revision 是名詞；revised 是過去式／分詞；revising 是 V-ing，三者都不能放在 decided to 後。

  2. 2. had to ______ the timetable.

    (A) adjust　(B) adjustment　(C) adjusted　(D) adjusting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：had to + base verb；adjust the timetable 是正確搭配。

    其他選項：adjustment 是名詞；adjusted 與 adjusting 都不符合 had to 後的原形要求。

  3. 3. the paragraph ______ a different cause.

    (A) indicated　(B) indication　(C) indicating　(D) indicates

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：主詞 reading／paragraph 的敘述在過去脈絡，indicated 是完整過去式。

    其他選項：indication 是名詞；indicating 不能作主要動詞；indicates 是現在式，與過去脈絡不一致。

  4. 4. they ______ to the next question.

    (A) proceed　(B) proceeding　(C) proceeded　(D) procedure

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：they 後用 proceed；proceed to the next question 是固定搭配。

    其他選項：proceeding 是 V-ing；proceeded 是過去式；procedure 是名詞。

  5. 5. each school ______ it in practice.

    (A) applies　(B) application　(C) applied　(D) applying

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：each school 是單數，且句子描述 will depend 下的實行方式，所以用 applies。

    其他選項：application 是名詞；applied 是過去式；applying 是 V-ing，皆不能作此處謂語。

  6. 6. instead of ______ a conclusion.

    (A) infer　(B) inference　(C) inferred　(D) inferring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 D：instead of + V-ing；inferring a conclusion 表示下結論。

    其他選項：infer 是原形；inference 是名詞；inferred 是過去式／分詞，均不接 instead of。

  7. 7. each measurement ______.

    (A) occurred　(B) occurs　(C) occurrence　(D) occurring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 B：each measurement 是單數，且圖表描述一般事實，使用 occurs。

    其他選項：occurred 改成過去事件；occurrence 是名詞；occurring 是分詞，均不能作此處謂語。

  8. 8. the example ______ included.

    (A) is　(B) be　(C) being　(D) was

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：被動句需要 is included；example 是單數的一般說明。

    其他選項：be 需其他助動詞；being 不是完整謂語；was 會把一般說明錯改成過去。

  9. 9. that ______ the meaning.

    (A) distorts　(B) distortion　(C) distorted　(D) distorting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：that 指單數 sentence，distorts the meaning 是現在式主句。

    其他選項：distortion 是名詞；distorted 是過去式／分詞；distorting 是 V-ing。

  10. 10. paragraphs ______ every task.

    (A) address　(B) addresses　(C) addressed　(D) addressing

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：both paragraphs 是複數，address every task 表示處理每項要求。

    其他選項：addresses 是單數；addressed 是過去式；addressing 是 V-ing，均不符合現在式複數謂語。

111｜公園｜word count: 181

Brainstorm：task、specific details、reason、effect、example、responsibility。

查看參考範文與解析

Park A offers open exercise space, while Park B provides trees, benches, and a quiet walking path. One is active and energetic; the other is peaceful and suitable for rest. Both are useful because a community needs places for movement as well as relaxation.

My ideal park would combine the two designs. It would have a safe playground, a walking path, shaded seats, green grass, and ramps for people with disabilities. I would also add a community garden. Children could play, adults could exercise, and older people could talk under the trees. Such a park would keep residents healthy and help neighbors build relationships. A park should not be designed for only one age group. Clear paths, drinking fountains, clean public toilets, and signs would make the space easier to use. Weekend activities could bring families together, while quiet corners would give busy workers a chance to recover. Good design can make a public place welcoming and safe for everyone.

This detail makes the example concrete and shows how the writer connects the situation to an everyday consequence for the community.

【自編練習｜sourceType: selfCreated】

第 24 課自編練習：逐題詳解

  1. 1. decided to ______ the conclusion.

    (A) revise　(B) revision　(C) revised　(D) revising

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：decided to + base verb；revise the conclusion 表示修改結論。

    其他選項：revision 是名詞；revised 是過去式／分詞；revising 是 V-ing，三者都不能放在 decided to 後。

  2. 2. had to ______ the timetable.

    (A) adjust　(B) adjustment　(C) adjusted　(D) adjusting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：had to + base verb；adjust the timetable 是正確搭配。

    其他選項：adjustment 是名詞；adjusted 與 adjusting 都不符合 had to 後的原形要求。

  3. 3. the paragraph ______ a different cause.

    (A) indicated　(B) indication　(C) indicating　(D) indicates

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：主詞 reading／paragraph 的敘述在過去脈絡，indicated 是完整過去式。

    其他選項：indication 是名詞；indicating 不能作主要動詞；indicates 是現在式，與過去脈絡不一致。

  4. 4. they ______ to the next question.

    (A) proceed　(B) proceeding　(C) proceeded　(D) procedure

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：they 後用 proceed；proceed to the next question 是固定搭配。

    其他選項：proceeding 是 V-ing；proceeded 是過去式；procedure 是名詞。

  5. 5. each school ______ it in practice.

    (A) applies　(B) application　(C) applied　(D) applying

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：each school 是單數，且句子描述 will depend 下的實行方式，所以用 applies。

    其他選項：application 是名詞；applied 是過去式；applying 是 V-ing，皆不能作此處謂語。

  6. 6. instead of ______ a conclusion.

    (A) infer　(B) inference　(C) inferred　(D) inferring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 D：instead of + V-ing；inferring a conclusion 表示下結論。

    其他選項：infer 是原形；inference 是名詞；inferred 是過去式／分詞，均不接 instead of。

  7. 7. each measurement ______.

    (A) occurred　(B) occurs　(C) occurrence　(D) occurring

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 B：each measurement 是單數，且圖表描述一般事實，使用 occurs。

    其他選項：occurred 改成過去事件；occurrence 是名詞；occurring 是分詞，均不能作此處謂語。

  8. 8. the example ______ included.

    (A) is　(B) be　(C) being　(D) was

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：被動句需要 is included；example 是單數的一般說明。

    其他選項：be 需其他助動詞；being 不是完整謂語；was 會把一般說明錯改成過去。

  9. 9. that ______ the meaning.

    (A) distorts　(B) distortion　(C) distorted　(D) distorting

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：that 指單數 sentence，distorts the meaning 是現在式主句。

    其他選項：distortion 是名詞；distorted 是過去式／分詞；distorting 是 V-ing。

  10. 10. paragraphs ______ every task.

    (A) address　(B) addresses　(C) addressed　(D) addressing

    本題專屬答案與四項解析

    正解 A：both paragraphs 是複數，address every task 表示處理每項要求。

    其他選項：addresses 是單數；addressed 是過去式；addressing 是 V-ing，均不符合現在式複數謂語。
